Prophets_Intro: Explore the stories of the prophets
Prophets_Chronology_Note: An approximate historical sequence. Some prophets lived at the same time, and the relative order of several prophets is uncertain.

Prophets_Lifespan_Nuh_Note: Quran 29:14 describes 950 years among his people. It does not give his total lifespan.
Prophets_Lifespan_Muhammad_Note: Sahih al-Bukhari 3902 reports that he died aged 63. No conversion between lunar and solar years is applied.

Prophets_Summary_adam: Allah taught Adam the names of things. This reminds us that knowledge is a gift from Allah.
Prophets_Caption_idris: An illustration of truthfulness and honour
Prophets_Summary_idris: The Quran describes Idris as truthful and a prophet. Allah raised him to a high station.
Prophets_Summary_nuh: Allah instructed Nuh to build the ark. By Allah’s mercy, it carried him and the believers through the flood.
Prophets_Caption_hud: The storm and the rescue of the believers
Prophets_Summary_hud: When the punishment came, Allah saved Hud and those who believed with him. Their rescue was a mercy from Allah.
Prophets_Caption_salih: The she-camel: a sign for Thamud
Prophets_Summary_salih: Allah gave Salih’s people a she-camel as a clear sign. Salih told them to let her graze and not harm her.
Prophets_Caption_ibrahim: The fire made cool and safe
Prophets_Summary_ibrahim: Allah commanded the fire to be cool and safe for Ibrahim. Allah protected him from its harm.
Prophets_Caption_lut: Leaving the town before the punishment
Prophets_Summary_lut: The angels told Lut to leave with his family during the night, except for his wife. Allah guided him away before the punishment came.
Prophets_Summary_ismail: Allah provided water for Hajar and her son Ismail through the spring of Zamzam. It brought relief when they needed water.
Prophets_Summary_ishaq: Allah’s messengers brought Ibrahim’s wife the good news of Ishaq, and of Yaqub after him. This was a joyful gift from Allah.
Prophets_Caption_yaqub: The shirt and the return of sight
Prophets_Summary_yaqub: When the good-news bearer placed Yusuf’s shirt over Yaqub’s face, his sight returned. This was a mercy from Allah.
Prophets_Caption_yusuf: The sun, moon and eleven stars in a dream
Prophets_Summary_yusuf: Yusuf told his father about a dream of eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing to him. His father told him that Allah would teach him to understand dreams.
Prophets_Summary_shuayb: Shuayb called his people to worship Allah and give honest weights and measures. He taught them not to take away other people’s rights.
Prophets_Summary_ayyub: Ayyub called upon Allah during his suffering. Allah told him to strike the ground with his foot, and provided cool water for washing and drinking.
Prophets_Caption_dhul_kifl: A symbol of patience and righteousness
Prophets_Summary_dhul_kifl: The Quran praises Dhul-Kifl for his patience and righteousness. Allah included him in His mercy.
Prophets_Caption_musa: The sea opening into a path
Prophets_Summary_musa: Allah told Musa to strike the sea with his staff. By Allah’s command, the sea divided and opened a way through.
Prophets_Caption_harun: A symbolic staff for Musa’s helper
Prophets_Summary_harun: Musa asked Allah to appoint his brother Harun as his helper. He wanted them to remember and praise Allah together.
Prophets_Summary_dawud: Allah made iron soft for Dawud and taught him to make armour. This was a special gift from Allah.
Prophets_Caption_sulayman: A kingdom and the language of creatures
Prophets_Summary_sulayman: Allah taught Sulayman the language of birds. He also understood an ant’s warning, smiled and thanked Allah for His gifts.
Prophets_Caption_ilyas: A landscape reminding us of Allah’s creation
Prophets_Summary_ilyas: Ilyas called his people to worship Allah, their Lord and the Lord of their ancestors. He reminded them to leave the worship of Baal.
Prophets_Caption_al_yasa: A symbolic landscape for a righteous prophet
Prophets_Summary_al_yasa: The Quran names Al-Yasa among those who were excellent. His example reminds us of goodness and faithfulness.
Prophets_Caption_yunus: The great fish and Allah’s rescue
Prophets_Summary_yunus: Yunus called upon Allah in the darkness. Allah answered his prayer and rescued him from distress.
Prophets_Caption_zakariya: The good news of Yahya’s birth
Prophets_Summary_zakariya: Allah gave Zakariyya the good news of a son named Yahya, even in his old age. Allah’s power is beyond what we expect.
Prophets_Caption_yahya: The scripture and the gift of wisdom
Prophets_Summary_yahya: Allah gave Yahya wisdom while he was still a child. The Quran praises his kindness, purity and care for his parents.
Prophets_Caption_isa: A bird from clay, by Allah’s permission
Prophets_Summary_isa: Isa shaped clay like a bird and breathed into it. By Allah’s permission, it became a living bird.
Prophets_Caption_muhammad: The Sacred Mosque and the Night Journey
Prophets_Summary_muhammad: Allah took Prophet Muhammad on a journey by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque. Allah showed him some of His signs.
Prophets_Chronology_Reference: Ibn Kathir, Stories of the Prophets; Quran 7:59-93, 11:71, 12:4-6, 19:7-34
